question: Which exact entries, Thumb callback identities, class identities and RAM roots are referenced by the opt-in checked .155 font adapter, beyond the existing target symbols?
prototype_hypothesis: Direct native leaves use restricted recovered ARM AAPCS prototypes. Identity-only or installed callbacks intentionally have no public prototype: their addresses/layout roles are audited, not promoted into a general callable ABI. All functions have even instruction entry and entry|1 Thumb callable; RAM/data have only their exact address.
callsite_evidence: Full AP size 12304852 bytes; independently checked SHA256 ea0bdf1920cb30223d616432af00565ca67622e6468328f5eab155f8cdc2fb9f. XIP file offset = instruction address - 0x0c0c0000; cached-flash class offset = data address - 0x2c0c0000. The 32-byte windows below are reproducible identity fingerprints, not complete function extents (short functions include following bytes), and NEVER allowlist ranges.

Literal audit found 45 unique firmware code/RAM/class literals in the adapter: 42 new exact records (31 functions and 11 data/globals), plus existing lv_obj_tree_walk (0x0c380574), lv_obj_refresh_style (0x0c38525c) and lv_cache_drop (0x0c8b8c9e). Code entries supplied even to call() are ORed with 1; stored/compared callbacks are already Thumb pointers. Include references not detected in this ELF build as well as reported violations.

control_flow_evidence: Source evidence: font-reload-investigation.md sections Confirmed behavior; pending glyph ownership and completion boundary; lower reset path and additional text owners; Ownership follow-up; Final closure. Its 24 barrier + 4 lifecycle + 5 registry probes execute selected native instructions with modeled leaves, not a complete hardware transaction.

Native disassembly independently checked at integration: cache_acquire 0x0c3a3860 calls class+12 then entry increment; list_remove 0x0c3a46dc updates intrusive links; count_cache_init 0x0c3a9e48 validates key fields and initializes RB/list without allocation; ft_mul_fix 0x0c424304 is signed multiply/round/shift.

Independently inspected callbacks 0x0c39fd94/0x0c39fd9a/0x0c39fdcc, outline destroy 0x0c3a09f4, gradient/image pending release 0x0c395bd0/0x0c395be0 and metrics/outline creates 0x0c3a5ef0/0x0c3a8bb8 against the pinned raw AP. Callback-only approval is identity/installation, not direct module calls.

Constructor 0x0c6a1260 stores vector comparator 0x0c69feb1, null create and destructor 0x0c6a12d5; cache class literal at 0x0c6a12c4 is 0x2ca168b4. Root literals at 0x0c6a12bc/0x0c6a12c8 are 0x200d3280/0x200d327c. Data tables independently read from cached-flash alias: size/count class+4 are 0x0c3a9eb1/0x0c3a9e49; vector-label class first four words are 0x2ca177e0, 0x0c6a1261, 0x0c6a132d, 0x0c6a5519.

Adapter keeps manager wrappers/fallback/record identity, validates all affected active/idle/cache ownership, prepares checked native-compatible storage, and refreshes text property 90 plus exact vector class. No unsafe native wrapper constructor, generic cache constructor, forced GPU wait/drain/reset or registry remove/add is authorized by these additions.

RAM roots are supported by inspected initializer/accessor/teardown evidence, not hashes of simulated memory. Scalar offsets and class-internal callbacks not directly referenced by the adapter do not acquire additional allowlist records.

ownership_analysis: Healthy serialized UI-owner-only experimental transaction. Preserve old descriptors until all audited ordinary glyph/cache holds and tasks are absent; checked preparation must unwind only its own resources. Paths are immutable generation-specific files, old path/face references release in native order, and wrapper fallback/user-data/record fields stay unchanged. Do not retain native preparation across callbacks or framework teardown. Empty queues and equal root pointers do not prove GPU recovery safety or lifecycle identity.
unsafe_assumptions: Device status remains NOT_PROBED. This imports static investigation evidence and exact address policy, not a production font-reload guarantee.
No .139 symbols, firmware ranges, verifier policy, signature rules, loader approvals or public callable promotions change. All additions remain restricted / STATIC_RECOVERED / PENDING.

The verifier builds its exact allowlist from symbol entry/callable addresses; PENDING is deliberately distinct from public veneer APPROVED. Records outside the scanned XIP range still document actual audited RAM/class literals rather than relying on a scanner blind spot.

Host tests model GPU/heap/I/O/cache or callback leaves as documented. Real TTF parsing, full fault matrix, concurrent/unknown owners, GPU recovery, framework restart and physical layout/rendering remain acceptance gates. Source/ELF hashes are snapshots, not a claim that the source snapshot produced the provided ELF.
No GPU reset/wait/drain helpers, unsafe native constructors, unrelated transitive addresses, broad ROM/RAM ranges or global cache flushes are added.
recommended_probe: Regenerate exact .155 C veneer/config and Rust bindings with normal canopus generators; check private native config without changing bindings. Validate every record/evidence schema, verify the provided ELF unchanged, assert every adapter address literal resolves exactly and that removing a newly required symbol still fails strict verification. Before any device deployment rebuild/reverify the final module, obtain normal artifact-specific signed receipt, run signed loader/hardware acceptance on exact AP with recoverable installation. No public veneer approval or supervisor native binding is needed for existing direct-call adapter; normal release/device gates remain mandatory.
